intro: El Salvador uses the US dollar and relies on remittances, textiles and coffee.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Remittances are about a quarter of the economy. Clothes factories, coffee and sugar are exports. In 2021 El Salvador became the first country to make Bitcoin legal tender, though in 2025 it was made optional.

chapters.title: Surf City
text: The government promotes the coast as 'Surf City' for tourism.
